excerpts: Effective from 4 June 2025 · ON3 WORKS LTD

**Resume extraction:** When you upload your resume (PDF), we use AI services (including Google Gemini and OpenAI) to automatically extract and structure information such as your name, contact details, work experience, education, skills, and qualifications.
